svg.title: PhaseNet: waveforms in, phase probabilities out
svg.desc: An abstract PhaseNet U-Net. A three-component seismogram with two overlapping earthquakes enters the encoder, which shortens the time axis and adds channels at every level (3001 by 8 down to 12 by 128). The decoder restores the time resolution, joined to the encoder by skip connections, and outputs the probability of P, S and noise for every sample; P and S peak at the arrivals of both events.
